segments.sn42.3:1.1: Atha kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.3:1.2: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.sn42.3:1.3: ‘yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti.
segments.sn42.3:1.5: “Alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
segments.sn42.3:1.6: Dutiyampi kho … pe … tatiyampi kho yodhājīvo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn42.3:1.8: “sutaṃ metaṃ, bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ yodhājīvānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ –
segments.sn42.3:1.9: ‘yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti.
segments.sn42.3:2.2: ‘alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī’ti.
segments.sn42.3:2.4: Yo so, gāmaṇi, yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tassa taṃ cittaṃ pubbe gahitaṃ [hīnaṃ (sī. pī.)] dukkaṭaṃ duppaṇihitaṃ –
segments.sn42.3:2.5: ‘ime sattā haññantu vā bajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesuṃ iti vā’ti.
segments.sn42.3:2.6: Tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti;
segments.sn42.3:2.7: so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajito nāma nirayo tattha upapajjatīti.
segments.sn42.3:2.8: Sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti –
segments.sn42.3:2.9: ‘yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’ti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
segments.sn42.3:2.10: Micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ, gāmaṇi, purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi – nirayaṃ vā tiracchānayoniṃ vā”ti.
segments.sn42.3:3.1: Evaṃ vutte, yodhājīvo gāmaṇi parodi, assūni pavattesi.
segments.sn42.3:3.3: ‘alaṃ, gāmaṇi, tiṭṭhatetaṃ; mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī’”ti.
segments.sn42.3:3.4: “Nāhaṃ, bhante, etaṃ rodāmi yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha;
segments.sn42.3:3.5: apicāhaṃ, bhante, pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi yodhājīvehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paluddho –
segments.sn42.3:3.6: ‘yo so yodhājīvo saṅgāme ussahati vāyamati, tamenaṃ ussahantaṃ vāyamantaṃ pare hananti pariyāpādenti, so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā parajitānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjatī’”ti.
segments.sn42.3:3.7: “Abhikkantaṃ, bhante … pe … ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan”ti.

lines: 355-357. Tatiye yodhājīvoti yuddhena jīvikaṃ kappanako dhammasaṅgāhakattherehi evaṃ gahitanāmo.
Parajito nāma nirayoti ayampi na visuṃ eko nirayo, avīcisseva pana ekasmiṃ koṭṭhāse pañcāvudhasannaddhā phalakahatthā hatthiassarathe āruyha saṅgāme yujjhantā viya paccanti, taṃ sandhāyetaṃ vuttaṃ.
“yuddhena jīvikaṃ kappanako”ti, ussāhaṃ vāyāmaṃ karotīti yujjhanavasena ussāhaṃ vāyāmaṃ karoti.
Duṭṭhu ṭhapitanti duṭṭhākārena attano paresañca atthāvahabhāvaṃ na gataṃ paṭipannaṃ.
Parehi saṅgāme jitā hatā ettha jāyantīti parajito nāma nirayo.
Eseva nayoti eso tatiye vutto eva atthato visesābhāvato.
